0.npc_text: Qiao Ren says nothing for a long moment. Then: "You are still alive. That is more than most men would have managed."

qiao_ren_ask_root.npc_text: "If you have a question, ask it before the night gets old."

player_choices.text: How long have you been with Shihan?

qiao_ren_ask_service.npc_text: "Long enough to know when she is curious, when she is reckless, and when those are the same thing. This journey has been all three."
